import sys
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

request_count = 0


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _send(self, status, body_bytes):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain" if isinstance(body_bytes, bytes) and b"<" not in body_bytes[:1] else "application/json")
        # For /echo, we'll set content-type after deciding
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body_bytes)

    def do_GET(self):
        global request_count
        request_count += 1

        if self.path == "/health":
            self._send(200, b"ok")
        elif self.path == "/count":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(str(request_count - 1).encode())
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "not found"}')

    def do_POST(self):
        global request_count
        request_count += 1

        if self.path == "/echo":
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(length)
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "not found"}')

    # Handle other methods with 404
    def do_PUT(self):
        global request_count
        request_count += 1
        self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "not found"}')

    def do_DELETE(self):
        global request_count
        request_count += 1
        self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "not found"}')

    def do_PATCH(self):
        global request_count
        request_count += 1
        self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "not found"}')

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass  # Suppress default logging


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = int(sys.argv[1])
    server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), Handler)
    print(f"Serving on port {port}")
    server.serve_forever()
